Key tokens ​

A <bind keys="…"> row takes one or more of these tokens, separated by commas: keys="q,ctrl+c". The same names are the steps of tuimark play --input. See Keymap, actions and focus.

Named keys ​

TokenKey
enterEnter / Return
escEscape
tabTab
backspaceBackspace
spaceSpace bar
upArrow up
downArrow down
leftArrow left
rightArrow right
homeHome
endEnd
pgupPage up
pgdnPage down
shift+tabShift + Tab

Other tokens ​

Also valid: ctrl+<a-z> (ctrl+i, ctrl+j, and ctrl+m arrive as tab/enter and never match), and any single printable ASCII character except space (write space) and , (the keys= list separator; a token of , binds nothing).
